headline: Confirmed measles cases in Mexico between 2025-2026
summary: Conasami will hold a permanent session next week to analyze the 2027 minimum wage increase, which must be set by December 1. The projection cited is 10,700 pesos per month.
why: Mexico's minimum wage sets a floor for labor costs across the economy, affecting retailers, manufacturers and service companies operating in the country.
